description:
Create a new User Group in Vicidial named 'SUP_SECURE' (Secure Supervisors) with restricted reporting capabilities. 

Goal: The group must allow access ONLY to 'Agent Performance Detail' and 'Real-Time Main Report', while strictly BLOCKING all 'Export' reports to prevent data theft. Additionally, force members to change their password on login.

Specifications:
- Group ID: SUP_SECURE
- Group Name: Secure Supervisors
- Description: Restricted Reporting Access
- Allowed Reports: Select ONLY 'Agent Performance Detail' and 'Real-Time Main Report'. Ensure NO export capabilities are allowed.
- Force Change Password: Y

Starting state: Vicidial Admin is open. Log in if prompted (User: 6666, Pass: andromeda).
